text:
maya: Holding the release cut — deploybot failing on promote, CI manifest fetch 404 for release-2026-03-23.

deploy-bot: [automated] promote failed: manifest fetch 404 for key ci/artifacts/20260323/abcd1234; retrying (1/5).

eli: I pulled the CI job logs — artifact manifest missing from the index. HTTP 404 from artifact-store (s3 gateway) around 02:14 UTC.

sasha: FWIW, the nightly gc-job ran yesterday and we accidentally tightened TTL to 48h during the maintenance patch. These artifacts are ~72h old. GC may have removed them.

maya: Ugh. Options:
- pin to last-good image sha: sha:abcdef123456 and promote manually
- re-upload artifact into ci/artifacts/20260323/abcd1234 then retry deploybot
- rollback the cut to the previous release
Change window closes in ~2h.

release-manager: Pin+reupload seems least risky. Pinging alone leaves rollout dependent on manual promote; reupload gives automated path. Agree with candidate plan.

eli: I can re-upload now. Will fetch the archived build from build-cache and push back to artifact-store. Command I’ll run:
```
aws s3 cp /tmp/reupload/release-20260323-abcd1234.tar s3://ci-artifacts/20260323/abcd1234 --metadata build=20260323 --acl bucket-owner-full-control
```
After upload I'll post the manifest and trigger /promote.

sasha: I reverted the GC config in staging and added a guard so TTL changes require a two-person approval. Created a follow-up ticket: INF-7283.

deploy-bot: promote triggered by @eli. attempting promote... promote succeeded: release-2026-03-23 -> production. :tada:

maya: Thanks everyone — unblocking the cut. Please add the GC rollback notes to the release notes (under infra caveats).

release-manager: Added infra note to release notes and flagged INF-7283 for next retro. Closing hold. :white_check_mark:
